notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout with haste.
The Hyrax Tower Scout token enters the battlefield, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Hyrax Tower Scout token, adding {R}.
The Hyrax Tower Scout token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
